title: AI Scrum CoP Community of Practice
body:
● Which model fits AI Scrum best?

  - SDD is the foundation — AI doesn't fill gaps charitably, it guesses. Precise specs eliminate hallucination surface.
  - DDD gives the vocabulary — business dictionary = ubiquitous language for prompts. Shared terms prevent "retrospective view" →
  wrong file.
  - BDD is already embedded — AC criteria are behavioral contracts; Hermes is the automated verifier.
  - Avoid spec-deferral patterns — emergent design, "implement as you see fit," vague stories all fail with AI agents.
  - AI-DLC = SDD over a DDD foundation — field types, execution constraints, workspace detection are SDD infrastructure for AI
  reliability.


Is there a discord server or slack channel for this group?
